task: instruction.md, environment/Dockerfile, environment/instructions/integration.md, task.toml, solution/solve.sh, solution/app/{package.json,server.js}, solution/app/src/{bootstrap.js,db.js,index.js (lines 1-60, 400-426, env/path greps)}, solution/app/public/index.html (asset tags), tests/test.sh (launch/restart sections), tests/Dockerfile
evidence: solve.sh (sha256 1df2ed04...030a, matches index): '#!/bin/bash' shebang + LF (od shows '#!/bin/bash\n'; grep finds no CR in solution/), `bash -n` OK, `set -euo pipefail`. It mkdir -p /app, resolves DB_PATH (default /app/app.db) and refuses if outside /app, only when a DB file already exists scans /proc fds to refuse resetting a live DB, then `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` and removes app.db/-wal/-shm so the install ships no database (brief: 'start with no shipped database'). It writes nothing to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, no NODE_ENV (grep over solution/ empty); no bare nproc; no npm/pip install, consistent with brief 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'. Only deps are express 5.1.0 + better-sqlite3 12.4.1 (package.json), preinstalled globally at the same pinned versions in BOTH environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, which test.sh passes via env -i (test.sh:104-111, 160-167). Entry: solution/app/server.js -> require('./src/index.js') -> bootstrap.start: main thread listens on Number(process.env.PORT||3000) on 0.0.0.0 and answers GET /api/health and /health without DB (bootstrap.js:20-23,43), then starts a Worker with env {...process.env, PORT:'0'} so DB_PATH propagates; worker opens DB at process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname,'..','app.db') = /app/app.db (db.js:9). Self-contained: seed read from __dirname/seed_data.json (db.js:10), byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c80...3740), so nothing reads /assets or /instructions at runtime (brief: 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime'); PUBLIC_DIR = __dirname/../public (index.js:42), index.html loads only local /styles.css and /js/*.js, no server-side outbound fetch. All paths are __dirname-relative so test.sh's fallback launch from /tmp/submission with DB_PATH=/tmp/submission/app.db (test.sh:90-101) also works. Seeding is idempotent: seedIfEmpty returns when users COUNT>0 and inserts in one transaction (db.js:61-85); schema uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Measured runtime evidence (hashes re-verified against index and frozen bytes): qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/workspace.cjs:16 spawns `node /app/server.js` with cwd /tmp and env {PATH,HOME,NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules,PORT=3000,DB_PATH=/tmp/hireops-workspace.db} in the verifier image as uid 65534; results/workspace.json has 20/20 groups passed incl. 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages and activity without reseeding; live updates resume', page_errors []; server.log shows two '[hireops] listening on 3000' (initial + restart). Broken-alternative probe: a reference that read /assets/seed_data.json at runtime, required npm install, or ignored DB_PATH would fail this row; this one does none of these. Conforming-alternative probe: a template-style solve.sh (plain cp -a) would equally satisfy the row; the extra DB-reset/guard logic is a stricter superset and is inert on a fresh Oracle container (no DB file -> exits 0 before /proc scan). Risk=true only because no measured evidence shows solve.sh itself performing the install followed by the real tests/test.sh launch path (setpriv/env -i/copy-aside) or an Oracle run; the scripted run approximates but does not prove that path. No defect found.
run_verdict: PARTIAL: scripted golden run CONFIRMS the reference starts as node /app/server.js under PORT/DB_PATH/NODE_PATH as uid 65534 with restart persistence; solve.sh-driven install + full test.sh launch (Oracle) NOT EXERCISED.
